captures.what_is_new: Octo Health, a Lisbon healthtech founded in 2023, has launched its personal health tracking platform in Portugal and the United States: medical records, lab results and device data in one place, clinical testing for more than 110 biomarkers across 11 health areas, recommendations meant to complement medical care. It follows a 2.7 million euro pre-seed round led by 3xP Global (as first reported by Jornal Económico). The company says users keep ownership of their records and the platform is HIPAA compliant and GDPR ready. Not tied to Web Summit in the article.
captures.is_story: yes: S20 (Portugal banner or short story), and a connection (S21)

for_the_fact_checker.what: The 2.7 million euro round is Portugal Startup News citing Jornal Económico; attribute it. HIPAA and GDPR are the company's own statements; attribute them as such.

Granter's round was led by 3xP Global's Impact Innovation Fund (r1255-15); Octo Health's by 3xP Global (this capture); Intuitivo's by Caixa Capital and 'the Impact Innovation Fund' (r1255-19), not named as 3xP's. Keep Intuitivo out of the 3xP link until checked (as for S14).
